I took the two `unittest.mock.patch.object` calls out of the new test, so the hook's mock count in `tests/test_variables.py` should be back to 23. I didn't re-run the hook itself. The new test still passes.

It now catches the `RuntimeWarning` and checks its text instead. The error path's message starts with `Error retrieving variables: Unexpected…`. The warning path's message has the exception class name (`UnexpectedResponse`) right after the colon.
